auth_variables.name: target
auth_variables.description: Named account target from ./infra targets; supplies the account identifiers and default region so the tfvars file does not repeat them.

auth_variables.name: databricks_account_id
auth_variables.description: Databricks account UUID, from the tfvars or the target; preflight verifies every Databricks session targets it.

auth_variables.name: aws_account_id
auth_variables.description: Expected AWS account; pins the AWS provider's allowed_account_ids and preflight identity checks. Required unless the target or ./infra setup supplies it.

auth_variables.name: aws_profile
auth_variables.description: Legacy fallback AWS CLI profile. Prefer ./infra setup, which records the profile outside Git.

auth_variables.name: databricks_profile
auth_variables.description: Legacy fallback Databricks account profile. Prefer ./infra setup.

auth_variables.name: databricks_workspace_profile
auth_variables.description: Legacy fallback Databricks workspace profile. Prefer ./infra setup after the workspace exists.

auth_variables.name: deployment_id
auth_variables.description: Set by ./infra on every plan; drives derived resource names. Do not set it in tfvars.

auth_variables.name: workspace_resources_enabled
auth_variables.description: Set by ./infra for the two-stage deployment of a new AWS workspace. Do not set it in tfvars.

workspace.summary: Databricks workspace in a dedicated VPC with private classic-compute subnets, NAT, root S3 storage, and a cross-account IAM role; serverless compute is available in the same workspace

backend_private_link.description: Route classic compute-to-control-plane traffic through back-end PrivateLink.

backend_private_link_subnets.description: Exactly two IPv4 endpoint subnet CIDRs, required when back-end PrivateLink is enabled.

public_access_enabled.description: Keep public workspace UI/API access. Operators and ./infra need it unless they run inside the private network.

name_prefix.description: Resource name prefix; derived from the deployment ID when null.

workspace.cost_note: NAT gateway and VPC endpoints bill hourly; clusters bill only while running

unity_catalog.summary: Unity Catalog metastore (reused or created), storage credential, external location, and an initial catalog

existing_metastore_name.description: Reuse an existing regional metastore instead of creating one. Most shared accounts already have one per region.

create_initial_catalog.description: Create the storage credential, external location, and initial catalog.

metastore_mode.description: create a dedicated metastore, assign existing_metastore_name, or auto-reuse the account metastore in the workspace region (creating one only if none exists).

glue_federation.summary: Private S3 sample data with an AWS Glue database and table, plus optional Unity Catalog federation objects

databricks_connectivity_enabled.description: Also create the Unity Catalog credentials, external location, connection, and foreign catalog. Requires workspace and unity_catalog.

rds_postgres.summary: Private Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL in its own VPC, with sample tables loaded by ./infra verify

engine_version.description: Optional PostgreSQL engine version. Required when Lakeflow Connect source setup is enabled so the matching parameter-group family is deterministic.

lakeflow_connect_enabled.description: Enable PostgreSQL logical-replication parameters and create a write-only Secrets Manager credential for Lakeflow Connect source setup.

rds_sql_server.summary: Private Amazon RDS for SQL Server Standard in its own VPC, suitable for Lakeflow Connect CDC, with sample tables loaded by ./infra verify
rds_sql_server.cost_note: SQL Server Standard license-included instance bills hourly

aurora_postgres.summary: Private Aurora PostgreSQL cluster with writer and reader endpoints in its own VPC

aurora_proxy.summary: RDS Proxy in front of the Aurora PostgreSQL cluster

rabbitmq.summary: Private self-managed RabbitMQ broker on EC2 in its own VPC

ephemeral_credentials.description: Write the broker password only to Secrets Manager (write-only attribute) so it is never stored in Terraform state. For new deployments.

kafka.summary: Private single-broker Kafka on EC2 with SASL credentials and a continuous synthetic event producer

topic_name.description: Topic written by the synthetic producer.

ephemeral_credentials.description: Write the broker password only to Secrets Manager (write-only attribute) so it is never stored in Terraform state. For new deployments.

simulated_on_prem.summary: Isolated VPC with an HTTP test host that stands in for an on-premises network

service_port.description: Port of the simulated on-premises HTTP test service.

classic_private_link.summary: Interface VPC endpoint in the workspace VPC for each source that classic compute reaches over PrivateLink, with an internal NLB and endpoint service on the source side
classic_private_link.cost_note: NLB and interface endpoints bill hourly

ncc.summary: Network Connectivity Configuration with a private endpoint rule per source that serverless compute reaches over PrivateLink

existing_network_connectivity_config_id.description: Reuse an existing NCC for serverless private endpoint rules instead of creating one.

endpoint_approval.description: auto: ./infra approves the serverless endpoint connections this deployment requested right after apply; manual: leave them pending to practice the approval step with ./infra endpoints.

transit_gateway.summary: Transit Gateway with attachments, routes, and security rules between the workspace VPC and the simulated on-premises VPC

lab_check.summary: Databricks job that loads the sample data into each database and checks every configured classic and serverless path; run it with ./infra verify

enabled.description: Create the lab check job when at least one source has a classic or serverless path.

classic_node_type.description: Node type for the single-node classic check cluster; the smallest general-purpose type with 4 cores when null.

lab_check.cost_note: Compute bills only while ./infra verify runs the job

connectivity_modes.none: No network path: this compute type cannot reach the source (useful for networking exercises).
connectivity_modes.peering: VPC peering between the workspace VPC and the source VPC, with routes and a security group rule for the source port.
connectivity_modes.private_link: AWS PrivateLink: an internal NLB and endpoint service in front of the source. Classic compute uses an interface endpoint in the workspace VPC; serverless compute uses an NCC private endpoint rule.
connectivity_modes.transit_gateway: AWS Transit Gateway between the workspace VPC and the simulated on-premises VPC.

auth_variables.name: target
auth_variables.description: Named account target from ./infra targets; supplies the account identifiers and default region so the tfvars file does not repeat them.

auth_variables.name: subscription_id
auth_variables.description: Required Azure subscription; preflight verifies the Azure CLI session for it without changing the active subscription.

auth_variables.name: tenant_id
auth_variables.description: Optional Entra tenant. ./infra supplies the tenant of the selected subscription so every provider uses it.

auth_variables.name: databricks_account_id
auth_variables.description: Azure Databricks account UUID, required for account-level Unity Catalog resources.

auth_variables.name: databricks_auth_type
auth_variables.description: Databricks auth type for providers without a profile. ./infra sets azure-cli for local sessions; automation leaves it null.

auth_variables.name: databricks_account_profile
auth_variables.description: Optional Databricks account OAuth profile. Without it, the Azure CLI identity is used.

auth_variables.name: databricks_workspace_profile
auth_variables.description: Optional Databricks workspace profile. Without it, the Azure CLI identity is used.

auth_variables.name: deployment_id
auth_variables.description: Set by ./infra on every plan; drives derived resource names. Do not set it in tfvars.

workspace.summary: Premium VNet-injected Azure Databricks workspace with secure cluster connectivity, NAT, and a private endpoint; serverless compute is available in the same workspace

front_end_private_link.description: Deprecated alias for browser_authentication; used only when browser_authentication is unset. Removed in the next release.

browser_authentication.description: Create the browser_authentication (browser SSO) private endpoint. The databricks_ui_api endpoint always exists.

public_network_access_enabled.description: Keep public workspace access. Disabling it requires front-end Private Link and running operators inside the private network.

name_prefix.description: Resource name prefix; derived from the deployment ID when null.

workspace_name.description: Workspace name; derived from the prefix when null.

workspace.cost_note: NAT gateway and private endpoints bill hourly; clusters bill only while running

test_vm.summary: Linux VM in the workspace VNet for private DNS and front-end Private Link tests (needs your public IP for SSH)

allowed_ssh_source_cidr.description: Required CIDR allowed to reach the test VM over SSH.

admin_ssh_public_key.description: OpenSSH public key; when set, password authentication is disabled.

external_volume_storage.summary: ADLS Gen2 storage with an access connector, metastore assignment, and a Unity Catalog external volume

public_network_access_enabled.description: Expose the storage account's public endpoint (protected by RBAC).

allow_unreachable_storage.description: Acknowledge a metadata-only deployment when storage has no public or private compute path.

metastore_mode.description: create a dedicated metastore, reuse metastore_id (existing), or auto: keep the managed one, reuse the only regional metastore, or create one; fails when several regional metastores exist.

metastore_id.description: Existing metastore ID, required when metastore_mode is existing.

volume_storage_path.description: Storage prefix backing the external volume; ./infra seed uploads here.

allow_force_destroy.description: Allow Unity Catalog force deletion for disposable environments.

custom_dns.summary: DNS forwarder VM set as the workspace VNet's custom DNS server

sql_database.summary: Private Azure SQL logical server and database with a private endpoint and private DNS, with sample tables loaded by ./infra verify

workspace_peering_enabled.description: Peer the SQL VNet with the workspace VNet and link its private DNS zone for classic compute and the test VM.

entra_admin_enabled.description: Make the deploying principal the SQL server Microsoft Entra administrator; SQL authentication stays enabled.

key_vault_enabled.description: Store generated SQL passwords in an RBAC Azure Key Vault.

databricks_secret_scope_enabled.description: Expose the Key Vault to the workspace as a Key Vault-backed secret scope (requires the workspace).

sql_server_vm.summary: Private SQL Server 2022 VM and a network prepared for an Azure Private Link Service exercise
sql_server_vm.cost_note: SQL Server VM license bills hourly

ncc.summary: Network Connectivity Configuration with a private endpoint rule to each source serverless compute reaches over Private Link

existing_network_connectivity_config_id.description: Reuse an existing Databricks NCC for serverless private endpoint rules.

endpoint_approval.description: auto: ./infra approves the serverless endpoint connections this deployment requested right after apply; manual: leave them pending to practice the approval step with ./infra endpoints.

key_vault.summary: RBAC Azure Key Vault with the generated SQL credentials, exposed to the workspace as a Key Vault-backed secret scope

vnet_peering.summary: Peering between the workspace VNet and the SQL VNet, with the SQL private DNS zone linked to the workspace

lab_check.summary: Databricks job that loads the sample data into each database and checks every configured classic and serverless path; run it with ./infra verify

enabled.description: Create the lab check job when at least one source has a classic or serverless path.

classic_node_type.description: Node type for the single-node classic check cluster; the smallest general-purpose type with 4 cores when null.

lab_check.cost_note: Compute bills only while ./infra verify runs the job

connectivity_modes.none: No network path: this compute type cannot reach the source (useful for networking exercises).
connectivity_modes.peering: VNet peering between the workspace VNet and the source VNet, with the source's private DNS zone linked to the workspace.
connectivity_modes.private_link: Azure Private Link: an NCC private endpoint rule that Databricks provisions to the source for serverless compute.
